story:
Christmas is about Jesus, the best gift God gave the world (John 3:16, Luke 2). Grandpa Sol tells the story to Zara, Eli and Pip, with a sing-along song at the end.

Memory verse: "God so loved the world that He gave His only Son" (John 3:16)
Memory line: Jesus is God's best gift!

Talk about it together:
Ages 2-3: Who is God's best gift? (Jesus!)
Ages 4-8: Why did God give us Jesus? What can we say to God for His gift? How can we share God's love with someone this week?
Prayer: Dear God, thank You for sending Jesus, Your best gift. Help us share Your love. Amen.
Activity (5 minutes): Draw a present with Jesus inside, and write "Thank You, God, for Jesus." Share one act of kindness today.

🎵 Sing along with the lyrics:

[Verse 1]
Ribbons, boxes, big and small
But God's best gift is the best of all
Not in a box, not tied with a bow
A tiny baby, long ago

[Chorus]
Jesus is God's best gift
Wrapped in love, a gift to lift
Born in Bethlehem for you and me
Jesus, our gift, our Savior, He!

[Verse 2]
"God so loved the world," we say
He sent His Son on Christmas day
Shepherds came and wise men too
Everyone found Him, it's true

[Chorus]
Jesus is God's best gift
Wrapped in love, a gift to lift
Born in Bethlehem for you and me
Jesus, our gift, our Savior, He!

[Verse 3]
Thank You, God, for sending Him
We will share His love with friends
Hugs and kindness, helping hands
Gifts of love across the land

[Chorus - lifted]
Jesus is God's best gift
Wrapped in love, a gift to lift
Born in Bethlehem for you and me
Jesus, our gift, our Savior, He!

[Outro]
Jesus is God's best gift!
Thank You, God!

#BibleStoriesForKids #Christmas #Eliora
